drums.tags: Industrial rock featuring a prominent, distorted drum machine loop and heavy electric guitar riffs. The track is in 4/4 time at 100 BPM in the key of E minor. A high-gain electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted rhythmic pattern that alternates with sustained power chords. The drum kit consists of a compressed, punchy kick drum and a metallic, gated snare. A distorted synthesizer bass follows the guitar riff exactly, adding low-end grit. The arrangement is repetitive and mechanical, focusing on a steady rhythmic drive without melodic variation.
